notes: ACIP evidence summary: GRADE certainty ratings, the 82% seroconversion and the 5.7 per 1,000 myopericarditis rate come from a systematic review and trials whose results are only linked, so no own computation is recorded. vaccine_outcome_type left null because the article reports cited immunogenicity and safety evidence rather than quantifying them itself.
view_issues: The text labels myopericarditis certainty 'very low [level 3]', but level 3 is defined as low certainty.
